desc: Prove that every valid contiguous substring is exactly a consecutive block of children of some node, including the top-level forest, and that block reversals generate arbitrary sibling permutations and independent transformations.
Parse the Dyck string with a stack into rooted nodes and a top-level forest.
Canonicalize each node by the sorted tuple of canonical child IDs.
Compute each node’s orbit size and apply the same formula to the top-level forest.
Implement factorials and inverse factorials modulo 998244353.
Handle leaves, repeated equivalent children, and the single-pair case.
Validate the solution against both public samples.
